neighbours.label: verbs and nouns of communicating with someone (talk to, communicate, contact, interact, chat)
fire: I joined an online forum so I could talk to other gardeners about my roses.
The workshop helps nurses communicate with patients who speak little English.
Students will interact with guest speakers after each session.
Please keep the emergency contact details for every parent up to date.
In large companies, staff often communicate only with their direct manager.
The app makes it easy to chat with friends who live abroad.
Good communication between departments saves the company a lot of time.
She finally got in touch with her cousin after many years.
quiet: I joined an online forum so I could buy seeds from other gardeners in my area.
The workshop helps nurses lift patients who cannot walk on their own.
Students will sit behind the guest speakers during each session.
Please keep the medical records for every child in the locked cabinet.
In large companies, staff often work only on a single small product.
The app makes it easy to pay for groceries while living abroad.
Good storage space in the warehouse saves the company a lot of time.
She finally moved back to her home town after many years.

notes: Card: ' communicate' x4, ' talk' x2, ' communication' x2, 'Inter|act', ' contact', Russian 'разговаривать'; output promotes between, liaison, chat, networking, consult. Near misses keep people and setting but use non-communicative actions.
